question: Why does the speaker claim this inquiry was not previously articulated even by tradition-knowers?
premises: The matter has been inquired into and spoken.
It was not spoken by others, even by those knowing convention and tradition.
It was not spoken by the speaker before either.
inference: The present articulation is presented as unprecedented even among knowers of tradition.
uncertainties: The scope of kaiḥ api is broad and may include various authorities.
plain_english: This was not inquired into or spoken by anyone, nor even by me, though I know the tradition of convention.
